title: Use HTTP status to determine whether to read the response body
goal: distinguishes between Promise completion, HTTP request success, and JSON parsing success.
summary: This question uses the browser's native Response to construct samples of success, 404 and 503. A status code should be displayed when an HTTP status error occurs, even if the body happens to have valid JSON.
tasks: Complete responseMessage(response). If response.ok is false, return “Reading failed: ” followed by response.status.
When successful, await response.json() returns the message in the object. Keep makeResponseMessage for previewing several HTTP samples.

example.note: fetch usually still gets Response when receiving 404 or 503, and can handle status other than 2xx by checking ok.

hint: Check the status first and then parse. The failure body may be plain text, and it cannot be assumed that all bodies will work as JSON.
